i.norm: Verifies that a numeric HTML entity without a trailing semicolon (e.g. "&#3") is NOT unescaped when the unescaper is constructed with no options, because the default behavior requires a semicolon (semiColonRequired). The input CharBuffer contains four null characters followed by "&#3" (no semicolon). The expected output preserves the entire input unchanged as a String.
No options supplied — defaults internally to OPTION.semiColonRequired
Build input: four null chars followed by "&#3" (numeric entity missing the closing semicolon)
Because semiColonRequired is active and "&#3" has no ";", the entity is left as-is
